subject: Re: NeuTra kickoff — benchmark status + tuning risk
body:
Hi both,

Status:

- Vera's port landed 03-30. Config system mapping done; the funnel configs (IAF with 3 stages, [100, 100] hidden layers, vs the affine/tril baseline) reproduce cleanly.
- Funnel benchmark: NeuTra with the IAF bijector reaches target rhat on the 100-dim funnel in roughly a sixth of the wall-clock of tuned vanilla HMC on our A100s. The affine baseline splits the difference — worth keeping in the docs as the cheap option.
- Internal calibration posterior #1 shows the same shape of win. #2 in progress.

Risk: the step-size tuner. The release tunes within a min/max step-size band with a leapfrog cap of 100, and the rhat-based objective is sensitive to that band on our posterior #2 — badly set bounds either blow past the leapfrog cap or crawl. Toolkit defaults can't ask users to hand-set the band, so I'm deriving it from a cheap pilot chain. Adds ~10% runtime, removes the sharpest edge. Will have numbers next status.

Umar
